contract: Preview masks are derived frame metadata, never canonical scene content or export/history/operation bytes.
Canonical source cache validity must not change solely because an active erase trace grows. Apply transient masks to an isolated cached source, preserving lower objects/background.
Translated duplicates and previously erased strokes remain eligible for bounded source reuse; use existing cache budgets and invalidation stamps.
Retained runs may not hide transient erase metadata. Mask validation, Cancel, Undo, terminal commit and camera/target/content invalidation remain enforced.

implementation.canonical: No canonical state/codec/history/API/version changes. AddEraseMasks and existing publication path remain terminal-only.
